emily: FYI customs flagged container C-73, holding manifest. This blocks EU marketplace SKUs needed for SI onboarding next week.
rafael: Which SKUs/serials are impacted? Any partial release possible?
jess: Blocked: rdx-gpu-48 (split across POs) and rdx-ssd-2tb. Customs wants matching serial ranges.
tom: We can reroute 16 GPUs from Dublin yard in ~36h but that eats buffer for Dedicated.
emily: Partner needs at least 8 GPUs in eu-west by Mon for install. Can we commit 8 from reroute pool?
rafael: Yes, we can allocate serials 1001..1008. Handoff ETA 2026-06-29 18:00 UTC.
legal: If we loan reserved units, we need a 30-day loan addendum and liability clause. I'll draft short form.
ops-bot: INFRA-6203 created for reassignment, owner @tom.
jess: SI wants a CSV with serials; I'll only send after legal sign-off. Sample: serial,sku,region,commit_type,eta
emily: Marketplace team: mark listing MKT-9901 as partial (8/40) once legal confirms. ops-bot, please queue.
ops-bot: Marketplace update queued: MKT-9901 -> partial (8/40).
emily: Timeline: Rafael confirm by 15:00, Legal sign addendum by 16:30, Tom to start handoff and update INFRA ticket. Reopen if customs clears rest.
